_readme: Hunter Hawke Sound credits. One object per credit, newest first. After editing, run: python3 scripts/build-credits.py  (it rewrites the list inside credits/index.html). Fields: title, type (Feature, Short, Documentary, Pilot, Commercial, Series; optional), role, director (only when credited as director), company (production company, or the person Backstage lists when no director is named), date (YYYY-MM, when it shot), location, link, poster (file in assets/posters/), hidden (true = kept in the data but not shown yet), note (internal, never shown).
